title: Filipino-Style Lumpia
description: Crispy Filipino spring rolls with a savory, meaty filling. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook ground pork until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
2. Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
3. Add Filipino-style seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes.
4. Lay a lumpia wrapper on a clean surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
5. Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water, then fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, followed by the sides, and roll the wrapper up to form a tight cylinder.
6. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
7. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. When the oil is hot, add a few of the lumpia to the skillet and fry until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
9. Remove the lumpia from the oil and drain on paper towels.
10. Serve the lumpia hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
